name: Silk
overview: Scripture portrays silk as a symbol of beauty, prosperity, and luxury, often associated with fine clothing and valuable merchandise. Proverbs 31 highlights silk as part of a virtuous woman's attire, emphasizing dignity and honor. In Ezekiel 16, silk is used metaphorically to describe God's lavish care and blessing upon Jerusalem, illustrating spiritual richness and splendor. Additionally, Revelation 18 lists silk among precious goods traded in a wealthy city, underscoring its status as a prized commodity.
